This service allows eligible patients to consult a pharmacist for certain common health conditions, helping the local community receive professional advice and clinical assessment.
outputCopy.localIntroduction:
Littleover is a neighbourhood ward situated within Derby. The area features a mix of residential areas and open spaces, with Clemson’s Park providing a notable landmark that contributes to the local history and character of the neighbourhood.

Residents across Littleover have access to useful civic and community facilities, including Blagreaves Library and Bramblebrook Community Centre. Healthcare provision in the area is well established, with NHS general practice services provided from The Lanes Medical Centre and Aspiro Healthcare - Hollybrook Medical Centre. Furthermore, Royal Derby Hospital is a major hospital facility situated within the neighbourhood.

Working alongside these existing medical services, Brook Pharmacy provides Pharmacy First consultations for eligible people from the selected area. The Pharmacy First scheme covers certain common health conditions, allowing individuals to discuss their health needs with a trained pharmacist. During each consultation, the pharmacist carefully assesses symptoms, relevant medicines and medical history. Depending on the findings, the outcome may include tailored advice, suitable treatment or a referral to another healthcare professional. Eligibility for the service and any recommended treatment depend entirely on the individual clinical assessment.
